findings.conclusion: The public CLI/maintenance entry files defer implementation loading until actual process policy succeeds. Low syntax target is only for stable rejection, and Core imports do not impose a global Node gate.

Main detection now compares real paths of the running files. The former alias mismatch cannot silently suppress the CLI. Missing argv/files and non-file URLs are handled. Regression tests invoke the actual symlink spelling and require CLI output; the recorded final actual-version matrix has no silent empty positive failures.

234 rejection operations across actual Node 18.20.8, 20.19.0, and 22.17.0 and both locales exit 2 with UNSUPPORTED_NODE_RUNTIME; target/recovery snapshots do not change and no proposal output is written. Hook stdin is empty in this fixture matrix.

Actual Node 22.18.0 and 24.11.0 cover Skill/Plugin and Git/non-Git installations, CLI/read-only Wiki queries, loopback resource serving, resume, adapter-none finalization and rollback. Actual 24.14.0 supplies a narrower Skill/non-Git smoke path; it is not a full repetition of every installation and rollback combination.

341 recorded fixture operations do not establish browser/Mermaid interaction, physical network disconnection, real host lifecycle delivery, automatic continuation, Bun behavior, or human acceptance. Adapter-none fixture finalization supplies no host evidence.

The actual check process and recorded host event process are displayed separately. Recorded Node versions are re-evaluated under the current policy; missing records remain unobserved, and an observed unsupported host Node yields a connection issue rather than readiness.

OpenCode separates Node from Bun metadata before loading Core. Bun compatibility Node fields do not reject or certify Bun. Implementation is stored outside the plugin discovery directory; a real OpenCode/Bun lifecycle remains unverified.

The current adopting parent root marker is applied and its matching migration journal is awaiting_host_verification, without host evidence. New CLI or fixture success must not be presented as a refreshed parent Codex Hook pass, and finalization must keep that boundary.
